title: Class 1 Sugar Beet Phytoglobin Shows Strong Affinity to Glyceraldehyde-3-Phosphate Dehydrogenase and DNA In Vitro.
authors: Groth, Leonard; Oda, Miho; Bulow, Leif
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甜菜I类植物球蛋白与GAPDH及DNA的体外结合亲和力，并用蛋白-蛋白/蛋白-DNA对接建模支持互作，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-DNA结合与对接方法对TF-DNA互作建模有借鉴意义。
abstract: Class 1 phytoglobins (Pgbs) are known for their multifunctional roles in plant stress responses, with recent studies suggesting broader interactions involving metabolic and transcriptional regulation. Interestingly, glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GAPDH) moonlights in many roles in colocalized spaces during cellular stress that are strikingly suitable for supporting Pgb function. This study investigates the molecular interactions of class 1 Pgb from sugar beet (Beta vulgaris), BvPgb 1.2, and an alanine-substituted mutant (C86A), focusing on their ability to bind GAPDH and DNA. Using dual-emission isothermal spectral shift (SpS) analysis, we report strong binding interactions with GAPDH, with dissociation constants (K(D)) of 260 +/- 50 nM for the recombinant wild-type protein (rWT) and a significantly stronger affinity for C86A (120 +/- 40 nM), suggesting that the cysteine residue limits the interaction. Remarkably strong DNA-binding affinities were also observed for both variants, displaying biphasic binding. This behavior is characteristic of hexacoordinated globins and reflects the presence of two distinct species: a fast-reacting open pentacoordinated form and a slow-reacting closed hexacoordinated form with high apparent affinity. Here, the K(D) in the open configuration was 120 +/- 50 nm and 50 +/- 20 nM for rWT and C86A, respectively. In the closed configuration, however, the cysteine appears to support the interaction, as the K(D) was measured at 100 +/- 10 pM and 230 +/- 60 pM for rWT and C86A, respectively. Protein-protein docking studies reinforced these findings, revealing electrostatically driven interactions between BvPgb 1.2 and GAPDH, characterized by a substantial buried surface area indicative of a stable, biologically relevant complex. Protein-DNA docking similarly confirmed energetically favorable binding near the heme pocket without obstructing ligand accessibility. Together, these findings indicate a potential regulatory role for BvPgb 1.2 through its interaction with GAPDH and DNA.
abstract_zh: 第1类植物球蛋白（Class 1 phytoglobins, Pgbs）以其在植物胁迫响应中的多功能角色而闻名，近期研究提示其涉及代谢和转录调控的更广泛相互作用。有趣的是，甘油醛-3-磷酸脱氢酶（glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase, GAPDH）在细胞应激期间于共定位空间中发挥多种兼职功能，这些功能与支持Pgb作用高度契合。本研究探讨了来自甜菜（Beta vulgaris）的第1类Pgb BvPgb 1.2及其丙氨酸取代突变体（C86A）的分子相互作用，重点关注其结合GAPDH和DNA的能力。利用双发射等温光谱位移（SpS）分析，我们报告了与GAPDH的强结合相互作用，重组野生型蛋白（rWT）的解离常数（K(D)）为260 ± 50 nM，而C86A的亲和力显著更强（120 ± 40 nM），表明半胱氨酸残基限制了该相互作用。两种变体还表现出显著强的DNA结合亲和力，呈现双相结合特征。该行为是六配位球蛋白的典型特征，反映了两种不同物种的存在：一种快速反应的开放五配位形式和一种慢速反应的闭合六配位形式，后者具有高表观亲和力。此处，开放构型中rWT和C86A的K(D)分别为120 ± 50 nM和50 ± 20 nM。然而，在闭合构型中，半胱氨酸似乎支持该相互作用，因为rWT和C86A的K(D)分别测得为100 ± 10 pM和230 ± 60 pM。蛋白质-蛋白质对接研究强化了这些发现，揭示了BvPgb 1.2与GAPDH之间由静电驱动的相互作用，其特征为较大的埋藏表面积，表明形成了稳定且生物学相关的复合物。蛋白质-DNA对接同样证实了血红素口袋附近存在能量上有利的结合，且不阻碍配体可及性。综合这些发现，表明BvPgb 1.2通过与GAPDH和DNA的相互作用可能发挥调控作用。
